subject: EdgeQuant discovery — alignment, pilot scope & access roadmap
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Thomas Reed <thomas.reed@edgequant.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-10T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Quick recap + next steps from today

Hi Thomas —

Thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap while it’s fresh:

Pain points you called out
- High latency for batch inference on your document-parsing pipeline (p95 spikes to ~1.6s during peak).
- Token costs that balloon during heavy ingestion windows; current infra has unpredictable unit economics.
- Safety/PII filtering requirements across customer classes; auditability is a must.

Goals we heard
- Target p95 latency <= 250ms for short requests (document classification) and consistent throughput for batched OCR enrichment.
- Reduce per-100k-token inference costs by ~30% compared to current managed endpoints.
- Maintain an auditable trail for prompts/outputs (retention + export).

Pilot outline (high-level)
- 6-week focused pilot with a 3-week evaluation sprint:
  * Week 0–1: access & environment setup, ingestion samples, prompt set definition (you provide 150 representative prompts and 5 labeled validation cases).
  * Week 2–4: run evals (latency, MRR/accuracy for routing), implement caching/batching profiles and a quantized model if needed.
  * Week 5–6: acceptance run, cost-analysis, and handoff playbook.

Success metrics for pilot
- Latency: p95 <= 250ms for short requests; throughput target of 120 reqs/s for batched jobs with tail percentiles within SLA.
- Quality: end-to-end accuracy uplift >= 5pp on labeled routing test set or parity with current baseline.
- Cost: projected token cost reduction >= 25–30% after batching and prefix caching.

Immediate asks / next steps (for kickstart)
1) Please confirm the 150-sample prompt set and 5 labeled validation cases by EOD Tue (2028-04-12).
2) Share an allowlisted service account or SFTP details for sample payloads; we prefer S3 presigned links.
3) Access details for your security lead to complete the checklist in the attached access_requirements doc.

Attachments: edgequant_access_requirements.pdf (access checklist & minimum environment), EQ_mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx (timeline & owner matrix).

I’ll open a calendar invite for the kickoff (target: Thu 4/12 or Fri 4/13 PT) once you confirm availability.

—
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

From: Thomas Reed <thomas.reed@edgequant.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@edgequant.com>
Date: 2028-04-10T17:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + next steps from today

Karthik —

Appreciate the thorough note. This matches our internal read. A couple clarifications:
- The 250ms p95 target is for our short-text classification flows (~<256 tokens). For the batched OCR enrichment (2–5k tokens typical), we care more about stable throughput than single-request latency.
- For labeled validation, we can get you 5 labeled cases + a 200-sample unlabeled holdout by Monday (4/16).
- Security: I’ll loop our infra security lead (Alyssa) — she’ll need the access checklist filled and our SOC2 contact info.

We’re good to kick off Thurs 4/12 at 10:00am PT. Please send the invite.

Also, can you include an initial estimate of token/unit economics for a 1M-token run so our finance person can eyeball it? Not a formal quote — ballpark only.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Thomas
VP Product, EdgeQuant
thomas.reed@edgequant.com | +1 617-555-0147

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Thomas Reed <thomas.reed@edgequant.com>, Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@edgequant.com>
Date: 2028-04-11T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: prep for EdgeQuant kickoff (Thu 4/12, 10:00am PT)

Marissa/Monica —

Per Thomas: kickoff confirmed Thu 4/12 at 10:00am PT. High-level plan and asks so we’re aligned before the call:

Owners
- AE (me): overall runbook, MAP, and timelines.
- Marissa (Solutions Eng): access to sample data, prompt/eval design, run evals, tune batching/profiles.
- Monica (Customer Success): acceptance criteria and handoff doc.

Pre-kick checklist (action items before Thu)
- Marissa: review edgequant_access_requirements.pdf and list any infra blockers (due EOD Wed).
- Monica: draft acceptance criteria sheet (use EQ_mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx as starting point).
- Karthik: prepare a 1M-token ballpark economics slide (cost delta with/without prefix caching & 8-bit quantization).

Agenda for kickoff (30–45m)
1) Intros & success metrics (10m)
2) Access / data handoff & security checklist (10m)
3) Eval plan and prompt set (10m)
4) Timeline & owners / next steps (5–10m)

Attachments for the call: edgequant_access_requirements.pdf (security checklist) — please review.

I’ll send the Zoom invite and a shared Drive folder (linked) that will house the prompt set + eval rubric.

—
Karthik

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Thomas Reed <thomas.reed@edgequant.com>, Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@edgequant.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-11T12:00:00-07:00
Subject: Kickoff invite + access links (Thu 4/12, 10:00am PT)

Thomas / Alyssa —

Thanks for confirming. Invite is attached — recurring calendar for the 6-week pilot planning blocked as a placeholder; we’ll prune after workshop.

Zoom: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/832078XXXX (passcode will be in calendar invite)
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3EdgeQuant-MAP (folder: /EdgeQuant/Pilot-2028-04)
DocuSign (MAP): https://app.docusign.com/transactions/abc123

Quick checklist for tomorrow (before 10:00am PT)
- Thomas: upload the 150-sample prompt set + the 5 labeled validation cases (folder: Pilot-2028-04/Inputs). If you can’t upload, provide S3 presigned links and we’ll pull them.
- Alyssa: please have the security contact complete the access checklist in edgequant_access_requirements.pdf and CC me — we’ll triage any questions in the kickoff.
- Marissa: I’ve asked you to prepare an initial evaluation plan and a short note on preferred batching profiles.

Ballpark economics (attached)
- 1M tokens, baseline (no prefix/KV cache): ~$420 (est), after batching & prefix caching: ~$290 (est). Final varies by model/seq length — Marissa will run a small sim during the sprint and we’ll refine.

If anything changes on your side, flag here and we’ll adjust. See you tomorrow.

—
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
attachments: EQ_mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx (map + owners), edgequant_access_requirements.pdf (security checklist)
